scope: Targeted execution of Tranche 3 test suite covering PNF, SNF, EKNF, 6NF, DKNF, RFNF, ETNF, and algebraic synthesis/decomposition boundary invariants

tests_verified.details: Verified Roth, Korth, & Silberschatz (1988) PNF nest/unnest bijectivity: unnest(nest(R)) = R on partitioned relations.
Verified that un-nesting non-partitioned relations loses functional scope and creates ambiguous associations.
Verified that Set Normal Form treats frozenset values as atomic domain elements under commutative scalar equality in 1NF.
Verified Carlo Zaniolo (1982) EKNF admittance of non-superkey dependencies where dependent belongs to an elementary key.
Separated BCNF ⊂ EKNF ⊂ 3NF via enrollment counterexample (satisfies 3NF but fails EKNF) and composite schema (satisfies EKNF but fails BCNF).
Verified Date, Darwen, & Lorentzos (2002) 6NF irreducibility: schema with single non-prime attribute passes while multi-attribute relvars fail.
Verified decomposition of wide temporal tables into independent 6NF relvars with trivial join dependencies.
Verified interval join of 6NF temporal relvars reconstructs the complete historical state losslessly.
Verified Fagin (1981) DKNF holds when all dependencies are consequences of domain types and candidate keys.
Verified that non-superkey dependencies trip typed violation refusal under DKNF evaluation.
Verified Vincent (1999) RFNF asserts no tuple value can be predicted from other tuple values under BCNF.
Verified Darwen, Date, & Fagin (2012) ETNF join dependency superkey component requirements.
Evaluated separating boundaries between BCNF, ETNF, and 5NF on candidate relation instances.
Verified Bernstein (1976) 3NF synthesis produces dependency-preserving subschemas with lossless candidate key preservation.
Verified Tsou & Fischer (1982) BCNF decomposition tree recursively isolates violating dependencies into lossless subschemas.
Verified minimal cover canonical reduction is invariant under random dependency orderings.
Detected and materialized 4 spurious tuples resulting from cyclic 3-way natural join on non-5NF relations.
Verified Graham-Yu-Ozsoyoglu (GYO) algorithm correctly identifies alpha-acyclic chains and cyclic triangle hypergraphs.
Verified GYO ear elimination emits deterministic, reproducible step traces.
Verified Beeri et al. (1983) property: for alpha-acyclic schemas, pairwise consistency implies global join consistency.
Verified Rissanen (1977) decomposition independence condition under functional dependencies.
Verified exact projection of functional dependencies onto attribute subsets.
Verified that candidate key sets never violate Sperner's theorem antichain upper bound C(n, floor(n/2)).
Verified inclusion dependency chase cycle detection on referential foreign key chains.
Verified foreign key referential integrity constraints as exact 1-cochain boundary maps between relvars.
